1.name: What Comes After
1.overview: Jin and Mira hunt a mysterious new Oni through Ninjago City — only for an unknown Master of Earth to crash the fight.

1.name: The New Masters
1.overview: Jin, Mira, and Nate reluctantly join forces when an armored Oni begins hunting Elemental Masters. An accidental combination of their powers reveals just how dangerous the new generation could become.

1.name: Cold Hands
1.overview: Jin and Mira track down the man who stole the Fire Keystone, expecting a thief. Instead, they find a martial arts master with an Elemental secret — and an unsettling interest in Nate.

1.name: Hush
1.overview: An Oni traps the team inside a battlefield where sound no longer exists. Forced to fight without words, Jin, Mira, and Nate begin learning how to move as one.

1.name: Pure Destruction
1.overview: A new Oni turns Jin and Mira's own powers against them. When a devastating injury reveals what lies beneath Nate's human form, the team is left questioning everything they thought they knew about him.

1.name: The Hollow
1.overview: Searching for answers about Nate, the team uncovers the truth behind the Oni's return.

1.name: A Lesson in Ice
1.overview: Ivo's obsession with understanding Nate crosses a dangerous line. As Jin and Mira launch a rescue mission, Jin is forced to rethink everything he knows.

1.name: The Shape of Ruin
1.overview: Regent finally steps onto the battlefield and effortlessly dismantles everything the Ninja throw at him. But instead of destroying Nate, he reveals a truth about his past that changes his identity forever.

1.name: Borrowed Elements
1.overview: Regent reveals what he really wants from the Fourfold Beacon. Meanwhile, Ivo discovers that his own research has given the Oni exactly what they needed.

1.name: Before the Black Dawn
1.overview: As Elemental Oni descend on Ninjago, former enemies are forced to fight side by side. Nate must finally decide who he is as the team unleashes its most powerful attack yet against Regent.

1.name: Burning Reputation
1.overview: With Ninjago rebuilding, Jin becomes the celebrated face of a new generation of Ninja. When the Fire Keystone unlocks power beyond anything he's felt before, the attention becomes harder to resist.

1.name: There You Are
1.overview: Jin secretly pushes the Fire Keystone further and wins a battle almost single-handedly. As Ninjago celebrates its newest hero, Mira begins wondering whether Jin is fighting to save people — or to be seen doing it.

1.name: Severed
1.overview: Sovereign reveals his true power by cutting Mira off from her Elements. When other Elemental Masters begin suffering the same fate, Ivo uncovers a plan that could change Ninjago forever.

1.name: All Eyes on Fire
1.overview: Jin's growing dependence on the Fire Keystone turns every victory into a bigger spectacle. But when his refusal to back down nearly costs Nate his life, winning no longer feels like enough.

1.name: Cold Truths
1.overview: Jin and Ivo's tension erupts into a brutal clash of Fire and Ice. While they fight over who deserves to control the Keystone, Sovereign makes his move.

1.name: Nothing Left to Prove
1.overview: Without the Fire Keystone, Jin suddenly feels powerless. A mission forces him to rediscover the skills that made him a hero long before anyone was watching.

1.name: The Severance
1.overview: Sovereign activates the Fourfold Beacon and Elemental Powers begin failing across Ninjago. With their greatest abilities disappearing, the Ninja prepare for a battle they may have to fight without them.

1.name: What Remains
1.overview: As Elemental Power continues to fade, each member of the team must decide who they are without it. Ivo faces the cost of his life's work, while Jin is offered the power he once believed he needed.

1.name: A Fire of His Own
1.overview: Sovereign begins the Severance as the Ninja launch a desperate assault on the Hollow. With the fate of every Elemental Master at stake, Jin must choose between possessing the greatest power — and becoming the person worthy of it.

overview: A new generation of Elemental Masters rises as the Oni begin returning in strange, evolving forms. But when the mysterious Nate discovers an impossible connection to their enemy, Jin, Mira, and their reluctant ally Master Ivo are pulled into a battle over identity, legacy, and the future of Elemental Power itself.

seasons.name: Black Dawn
seasons.overview: A strange new breed of Oni is testing Ninjago's newest Elemental Masters — and every fight is teaching them how to become stronger. As Nate discovers an impossible truth about himself, the search for the Fourfold Beacon draws the team toward an enemy who wants to rewrite the bond between Elemental Masters and their powers.
